name: Portfolio page composition contract
goal: Compose new pages from canonical shared primitives without inventing parallel visual systems.

default_sequence.required: long-form case study with stable anchors

chapter_contract.label: Use pds-case-study-chapter-label for chapter numbering/eyebrow typography.
chapter_contract.title: Import shared chapter-title CSS and apply pds-case-study-chapter-title to an h2; new consumers wrap naturally.
chapter_contract.content: Narrative, evidence, images, and product semantics stay local.

prohibitions: Do not create a page-specific navigation/header when Navigation fits.
Do not copy shared component CSS into a consumer.
Do not promote project-specific content into a shared primitive solely for visual reuse.
Do not select deprecated components for new pages.
Do not infer undocumented design tokens from repeated legacy values.
Do not deploy as a side effect of page composition work.
verification: Compare existing consumers when a shared component or extend-status pattern changes.
